_comment: Bestiary manifest (tools/tree_library.json house style). Each entry drives one species build: python tools/creature_forge/gen_creature.py --manifest tools/creature_forge/bestiary.json [--only <id>]. 'combat': true requires idle/walk/attack/death clips (checks BLOCK otherwise) and stamps attack clip_meta. 'monsterId' names the resources/monsters stat block the visual binding will reference (M6). Output filenames: forge_ prefix defers path-morphology to the bone heuristic (CharacterVisualResolver forge_ rule, M2).
